description: This file defines configuration handling functions for Twitch accounts within the openclaw project, including account retrieval, listing, and context resolution.

methods.name: getAccountConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the Twitch account configuration for a given account ID, handling both default and explicit accounts.

methods.name: listAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured Twitch account IDs, including implicit default if base-level config exists.

methods.name: resolveDefaultTwitchAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default Twitch account ID based on configuration preferences and available accounts.

methods.name: resolveTwitchAccountContext
methods.description: Provides the full context for a Twitch account, including configuration, token resolution, and availability.

methods.name: resolveTwitchSnapshotAccountId
methods.description: Finds the account ID associated with a given Twitch account configuration.
